wallpaper_cage.description: The symmetry seam. Rotation is a continuous dial: any real angle preserves the circle. A periodic planar lattice permits only rotation orders 1, 2, 3, 4 and 6. Amber marks the continuous dial, blue the compatible lattice orders, and red the excluded orders 5 and 7. These restrictions concern the whole lattice, not shapes placed inside a motif. The cage diagrams the crystallographic rotation restriction; it does not derive the full classification of 17 wallpaper groups.
wallpaper_cage.name: Wallpaper Cage
wallpaper_cage.qfep_connection: A station in the bias landscape (doc/SEAM_PER_SEQUENCE.md); the digital-bias seam for symmetry. Bias is conserved; show the seam.
